description: User signs in with a registered email and correct password
preconditions: A registered user account exists and is not locked
test steps:
Open the login page
Enter a valid email and password
Click Sign in
expected result:
The login page is displayed
The form accepts the credentials
The user is redirected to the home page and the session is active

description: User cannot sign in when the password is wrong
test steps:
Open the login page
Enter a valid email and an incorrect password
Click Sign in
expected result:
The login page is displayed
The fields accept input
An error message is shown and the user stays on the login page

description: Validation when email or password is missing
test steps:
Open the login page
Leave email and password empty
Click Sign in
expected result:
The login page is displayed
The fields are empty
Validation errors are shown for required fields and no session is created

description: User with a locked account cannot sign in
preconditions: The user account exists and is locked by an administrator
test steps:
Open the login page
Enter the locked user's email and password
Click Sign in
expected result:
The login page is displayed
The form accepts input
A message indicates the account is locked and sign-in is denied
